flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/agencies/lta/{upload/helpers/LtaUploadHelper,download/helpers/LtaProcessingOrchestrator} (scheduled LTA enquiry for stage-ROV notices, stores owner and lta_deregistration_date), cron-schedules-prod.properties; ocmsadminapi workflows/reports/system/rip/RipReportServiceImpl (no LTA/DOS call, no owner comparison). No old-vs-new ownership comparison in the six repos
note: The story asks OCMS to immediately fetch the latest vehicle ownership data from DOS for the identified vehicles so the report can show an ownership change. Code only has the generic LTA enquiry (LTA Upload/Download) that runs on a schedule for stage-ROV notices; it is not triggered from a RIP vehicle list, is not real-time, and does not compare the old owner with the new one. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. Ticket: OCMS-DF-2026-160 (Pending Closure) reports notices losing ownership retrieval in the LTA ROV Enquiry, so this generic path also has an open defect
recommendation: Do not claim in full. Only the generic LTA enquiry exists; the trigger from the RIP list, 'immediately' and the ownership-change indicator do not exist

steps.step: The list of identified vehicle numbers is passed on for an ownership enquiry
steps.detail: The RIP report only reads the database and returns the result to the screen (RipReportServiceImpl.java:51-54, :94-95). The vehicle list is not forwarded to LTA/DOS or to an enquiry cron.

steps.step: OCMS immediately fetches the latest vehicle ownership data from DOS
steps.detail: The LTA enquiry mechanism exists but is generic: LtaUploadHelper selects stage-ROV notices of type O/E (LtaUploadHelper.java:88, :211-213) and the cron.ltaupload job is enabled=true, running at 03:00 and 19:00 (cron-schedules-prod.properties:134-137), sending a file to LTA over SFTP (partner and real server values cannot be verified from the repo). So it is not 'immediately', not for vehicles from the RIP report, and a notice already under PS-RIP/RP2 is not picked up through this path. OCMS-DF-2026-160 (Pending Closure): notices lose ownership retrieval. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo.

steps.step: The report indicates whether there is a change in vehicle ownership
steps.detail: The RipReportRecord built in RipReportServiceImpl.java:472-499 has no old/new owner field or change indicator. LtaProcessingOrchestrator.java:323-338 only stores lta_deregistration_date from LTA; grep for ownership change, ownerChanged and change owner in the six repos finds no owner comparison.
